# MMLAW Law Firm (mmlaw.ge)

> MMLAW is a criminal defence law firm in Georgia (office in Tbilisi) with more than 10 years of practice. Criminal law is its main practice: it defends accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims at every stage — from the first contact with the investigating authority, through interviews and questioning, investigative actions, preventive measures and trial (including jury trials) to the final decision of the Supreme Court. Areas include drug, property, economic, corruption, violent and cyber crimes, and juvenile cases. The firm also handles civil, administrative, labour, corporate, real estate, family, inheritance and intellectual property matters. Consultations in Georgian, English and Russian; the first consultation is free.

- Lawyer: Mariam Madzgharashvili (მარიამ მაძღარაშვილი). Lawyer, member of the Georgian Bar Association, specialising in criminal law, and a member of the Association's Jury Trial Committee. She focuses on criminal law, juvenile justice and children's rights, and holds a doctorate in law. Works in Georgian, English and Russian. Bar registry profile: https://gba.ge/en/Lawyers/Lawyer's%20Profile?lawyer=712
- Phone / WhatsApp: +995 551 00 43 00
- Email: info@mmlaw.ge
- Office: Tbilisi, Georgia. Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00
- Languages: Georgian (default, https://mmlaw.ge/ka/), English (https://mmlaw.ge/en/), Russian (https://mmlaw.ge/ru/)

## Practice areas

- [Criminal defense](https://mmlaw.ge/en/criminal-defense-lawyer/): MMLAW criminal defense lawyers represent accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims at every stage of a criminal case in Georgia — from the first contact with the investigating authority to the final decision of the Supreme Court.
- [Drug offences](https://mmlaw.ge/en/drug-crime-lawyer/): Drug crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims in drug-related criminal and administrative cases — from the first minute of an arrest or search.
- [Cybercrime](https://mmlaw.ge/en/cybercrime-lawyer/): We defend accused persons and witnesses in cybercrime cases in Georgia and help victims of online fraud, account hacking, blackmail and other digital harm.
- [Property crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/property-crime-lawyer/): Property crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims in cases of theft, robbery, fraud, extortion, embezzlement and misappropriation.
- [Economic crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/economic-crime-lawyer/): Economic crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend company directors, business owners and individuals against tax evasion, money laundering, customs violations and other economic charges.
- [Corruption and official crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/corruption-crime-lawyer/): Corruption crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend public officials, business owners and individuals in cases of bribery, trading in influence and abuse or excess of official power.
- [Violent crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/violent-crime-lawyer/): Violent crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims in cases of bodily injury, violence, threats and homicide, and we help victims.
- [Juvenile justice](https://mmlaw.ge/en/juvenile-justice-lawyer/): We defend children and young people in criminal and related proceedings under Georgia's Juvenile Justice Code, with a focus on rehabilitation and the child's best interests.
- [Civil litigation](https://mmlaw.ge/en/civil-litigation-lawyer/): We represent individuals and companies in civil disputes in Georgia — from pre-trial negotiation through all three court instances.
- [Administrative law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/administrative-law-lawyer/): We help individuals and businesses challenge unlawful decisions of public authorities and navigate licensing, permit and regulatory procedures in Georgia.
- [Labor disputes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/employment-lawyer/): We represent employees and employers in labour disputes under the Labour Code of Georgia — from unlawful dismissal to drafting contracts and workplace policies.
- [Corporate law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/corporate-lawyer/): Strategic legal support for businesses in Georgia — from company registration to mergers and acquisitions, compliance and restructuring.
- [Real estate](https://mmlaw.ge/en/real-estate-lawyer/): Full legal support for real estate in Georgia — checking the property, structuring and signing the deal, registering ownership and resolving disputes.
- [Family law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/family-lawyer/): Discreet, professional representation in divorce, child residence, alimony and division of marital property in Georgia.
- [Inheritance](https://mmlaw.ge/en/inheritance-lawyer/): We help you accept an inheritance in Georgia, obtain the certificate of inheritance and register the property in your name — and represent you in disputes between heirs.
- [Intellectual property](https://mmlaw.ge/en/intellectual-property-lawyer/): We protect brands, creative works and inventions — from registration with Sakpatenti to disputes with infringers.
- [Fraud cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/fraud-lawyer/): In fraud cases we defend the accused and help victims get their money back — investment schemes, loans, online and crypto fraud, and business deals.
- [Financial crime victims](https://mmlaw.ge/en/financial-crime-victims/): Since 2025, victims of fraud, extortion, embezzlement and other financial crimes have a new, effective way to recover their losses. We use it for you — from the investigation to the money in your account.
- [Tax disputes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/tax-lawyer/): We represent you before the Revenue Service — during audits, when appealing a tax demand, when reducing tax debt and, if needed, in a criminal tax evasion case.
- [Money laundering cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/money-laundering-lawyer/): A money laundering case often starts with a bank report or a frozen account. We defend individuals and companies — from proving the lawful origin of assets to the courtroom.
- [Asset freezing and confiscation](https://mmlaw.ge/en/asset-freezing-and-confiscation/): When the state freezes property or a bank account, or seeks confiscation, both business and family life stop at once. We challenge freezes, protect third parties' property and prove the lawful origin of assets.
- [Abuse-of-office cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/abuse-of-office-lawyer/): We defend public officials, employees of public legal entities and company managers charged with abuse of official authority, exceeding authority or negligence.
- [Smuggling and customs cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/smuggling-and-customs-lawyer/): We defend individuals and companies in cases of breaking the rules for moving goods across Georgia's customs border — from ordinary goods to jewellery and cultural heritage.
- [Director liability and insolvency](https://mmlaw.ge/en/director-liability-and-insolvency/): We defend company directors and partners — when the company is in debt, facing insolvency, or when a manager faces civil or criminal liability. We also protect creditors.
- [Drug possession cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/drug-possession-lawyer/): Buying or keeping drugs is the most common drug case in Georgia (the country). Everything turns on the quantity, the lab report and whether the search was lawful — even a fraction of a gram changes the part of the article and the sentence.
- [Removing a criminal record](https://mmlaw.ge/en/criminal-record-removal/): A criminal record gets in the way of jobs, visas, emigration and much more. By law it expires after a set period, and if you have behaved impeccably since serving your sentence, a court can remove it even earlier.
- [Early release on parole](https://mmlaw.ge/en/early-release-on-parole/): A person sentenced to imprisonment can be released early on parole if they have served the required part of the sentence and it is found that serving the full term is no longer needed for their rehabilitation. We help prisoners and their families prepare the application and the evidence.
- [Pyramid scheme and investment fraud cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/pyramid-schemes-investment-fraud/): Pyramid schemes and fake investment platforms always work the same way: promised high returns are paid with new participants' money until the scheme collapses. We help victims get their money back and defend people accused of taking part.
- [Help with blackmail over private photos](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blackmail-private-photos/): Blackmail with private photos or information is one of the hardest situations — people often tell no one out of shame. The law is strict here: demanding money is extortion, and spreading intimate images violates the secret of private life, with up to 10 years in prison. We act fast and in confidence.
- [Time-barred loan cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/time-barred-loans/): An old loan — from a bank, a microfinance company or a private person — becomes time-barred after a period set by law. But nothing disappears automatically: the debtor must raise the time bar, and even one 'small' payment restarts the clock.
- [Restraining and protective order cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/restraining-protective-orders/): Restraining and protective orders are the main tools against domestic violence and violence against women in Georgia. We help victims obtain an order and defend the person it was issued against — through an appeal, cancellation, or when accused of a breach.
- [Removing a seizure on accounts and property](https://mmlaw.ge/en/removing-seizure-on-account/): A seizure on an account or property often appears out of nowhere — because of an old debt, a court decision or a fine. We find out what it is based on and the fastest way to lift it.
- [Pardon and amnesty](https://mmlaw.ge/en/pardon-and-amnesty/): A pardon and an amnesty are two different ways of being fully or partly released from a sentence. We help convicted people and their families find out which applies to them and prepare the request.
- [Driving licence suspension cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/driving-licence-suspension/): For many people, losing their licence means losing their job. We check whether the test was done lawfully and the record properly drawn up, and appeal the decision within the 10-day deadline.
- [Appealing fines](https://mmlaw.ge/en/appealing-fines/): Camera and patrol fines aren't always right: sometimes someone else was driving, a sign wasn't visible or the record was drawn up incorrectly. We assess whether an appeal is worth it and file it on time.
- [Compensation for moral damage](https://mmlaw.ge/en/moral-damage-compensation/): Moral damage — pain, distress, damaged dignity — can't be measured exactly in money, but the law provides for compensation in certain cases. We assess how realistic your claim is and prepare the lawsuit.
- [Establishing paternity](https://mmlaw.ge/en/establishing-paternity/): When parents aren't married and don't make a joint declaration, a child's paternity is established in court. We prepare the claim, request a DNA test and protect the interests of the child or the parent.
- [Taking a child abroad — consent and disputes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/taking-a-child-abroad/): Taking a child abroad is often disputed — especially when parents live apart. We find out what the law requires in your case and resolve the dispute — by agreement or in court.
- [Challenging a dismissal](https://mmlaw.ge/en/unfair-dismissal/): Under the Labour Code, an employee can be dismissed only on grounds set by law. We check whether your dismissal was lawful and protect your interests — through reinstatement, compensation and back pay.
- [Protecting employee rights — leave, maternity, salary](https://mmlaw.ge/en/labour-code-leave-salary/): The main rules of the Georgian Labour Code in plain language — and help when an employer doesn't follow them: unpaid salary, overtime, leave or maternity leave.
- [Removal from the debtors' register](https://mmlaw.ge/en/debtors-register/): Being on the debtors' register means enforcement has started against you: selling property is restricted and bank accounts are frozen. We find out why you're on the register and how you can be removed.
- [Marital property division cases](https://mmlaw.ge/en/marital-property-division/): Property acquired during marriage is usually joint — even if registered in one spouse's name. We help divide it fairly — by agreement or in court.
- [Making and challenging a will](https://mmlaw.ge/en/wills-in-georgia/): With a will, you decide who gets your property. We help you make a will that no one can successfully contest — and we protect heirs when a will is unfair or was made in breach of the law.
- [Debt recovery](https://mmlaw.ge/en/debt-recovery-georgia/): A debt can be recovered through the courts or — if the contract was certified by a notary — even without going to court. We assess your documents, choose the fastest route and make sure the debtor doesn't dispose of their assets.
- [Contract drafting and review](https://mmlaw.ge/en/contract-drafting-review/): A good contract keeps you out of disputes; a bad one causes them. We draft contracts in your interest and review the other side's text before you sign: the risks, deadlines, penalties and what happens if something is not delivered.
- [Gambling ban for a family member](https://mmlaw.ge/en/gambling-ban-family-member/): If a family member is addicted to gambling and harming the family, they can be placed on the list of gambling-dependent persons. For the next 5 years no casino, slot hall, betting shop or online casino can let them play. A family member files the application with the court — we prepare it and gather the evidence.
- [Gambling debts and family property](https://mmlaw.ge/en/gambling-debts-georgia/): A loan taken for gambling is an ordinary debt — the bank or microfinance lender doesn't care what it was spent on. But one spouse's debt is not automatically the whole family's debt. We help you protect your share, deal with the debts and stop new ones.
- [Apartment for a lump sum (girao)](https://mmlaw.ge/en/girao-apartment-lump-sum-georgia/): Girao means you give the owner a lump sum, live in the flat rent-free and get the money back at the end. Legally it is a loan secured by a mortgage on the flat. If the contract isn't done properly and registered, getting your money back can be very hard. We check the flat, prepare the contract and protect you in a dispute.
- [Apartment lease agreement](https://mmlaw.ge/en/apartment-lease-georgia/): A well-drafted lease protects both sides — the landlord and the tenant. We draft leases in Georgian and English or Russian, check the flat and help in disputes — from unpaid rent to eviction.
- [Mortgage](https://mmlaw.ge/en/mortgage-georgia/): A mortgage is a debt secured by property — a bank loan, a private loan or girao. We check the contract before you sign, defend owners when a bank or private lender tries to auction a home, and act for creditors who aren't being repaid.
- [Land registration](https://mmlaw.ge/en/land-registration-georgia/): The state's free systematic registration ended on 1 January 2026. Unregistered land is now registered on your own application — the sporadic procedure. We check your documents, prepare the application, resolve overlaps with neighbours and act for you if you are refused.
- [Building on agricultural land](https://mmlaw.ge/en/building-on-agricultural-land-georgia/): Building an individual house on a privately owned agricultural plot is often allowed — if it fits the zone or the surrounding buildings. For other non-farm uses, the land's designation has to change first. We check what is and isn't allowed and prepare the application.
- [Bringing medication into Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/bringing-medication-into-georgia/): Many medicines that are ordinary elsewhere — Lyrica (pregabalin), tramadol, codeine products, ADHD medication, sleeping pills and sedatives — are under special control in Georgia. You can bring them in, but only with proper documents. Without them, a criminal case can start.
- [Lyrica, tramadol and prescription pills](https://mmlaw.ge/en/pregabalin-tramadol-georgia/): In Georgia, Lyrica (pregabalin) and tramadol are psychotropic and potent substances. Obtaining or keeping them without a prescription is a crime (Article 261), and selling them is far more serious. We defend the accused from the forensic examination to the courtroom.
- [Drug dealing charges](https://mmlaw.ge/en/drug-dealing-charges-georgia/): Since the 2025 reform, drug dealing has moved out of Article 260 into separate articles: free transfer (260²), sale (260³) and assisting a sale (260⁴). The penalty depends on the substance and the amount — and can reach life imprisonment. In these cases you need a lawyer from the first minute.
- [Drug tests](https://mmlaw.ge/en/drug-test-georgia/): The police may take you for a test to check for drug use. Avoiding the test is itself an offence — with a fine or administrative detention. We explain your rights, how the test works and how to challenge the result.
- [Cocaine, ecstasy and other club drugs](https://mmlaw.ge/en/cocaine-mdma-amphetamine-georgia/): In a cocaine, ecstasy or amphetamine case, the amount decides almost everything — and the thresholds are tiny: 0.6 g of cocaine is already a 'large amount'. Below is the law's official table and the penalties. In such a case you need a lawyer before the first interview.
- [Tax on freelance and foreign income in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/freelancer-tax-georgia/): If you live in Georgia and work remotely for foreign clients or a foreign company, the money comes from abroad, but the income is taxed in Georgia. We help you choose the right route, register and file returns — without overpaying tax or penalties.

## For foreigners in Georgia

- [Legal help for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/): Moving to Georgia, buying property, starting a business or facing a legal problem here? We advise foreigners in English and Russian — at our Tbilisi office or remotely.
- [Criminal defense lawyer for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/criminal-defense-for-foreigners/): When a foreigner faces a criminal case in Georgia, language and unfamiliar procedure are the first obstacles. We defend you in English or Russian — from the moment of arrest to trial.
- [Immigration lawyer in Tbilisi — entry bans, deportation](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/immigration-lawyer-georgia/): When you are turned away at the border, have overstayed or face deportation, time is very short. We act from day one — in English or Russian, in Georgia or remotely.
- [Buying property in Georgia as a foreigner](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/buying-property-in-georgia/): Foreigners can buy apartments, houses and non-agricultural land in Georgia on the same terms as Georgians. We check the property, prepare the contract and register your ownership — even if you are abroad.
- [Disputes with property developers in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/disputes-with-developers/): When you buy a flat in a new build, the biggest risk is the developer. We help buyers — including foreigners — get their flat or their money back, through negotiation or in court.
- [How to register a business in Georgia as a foreigner](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/company-registration-in-georgia/): Foreigners can own 100% of a Georgian company and run it from abroad. We register LLCs, branches and individual entrepreneurs, prepare corporate documents and support you with banks, contracts and tax registration. Prices (GEL, VAT included): Company (LLC) registration 1 800; Company (LLC) registration  remote 2 700; Virtual business address 500 per year; Personal bank account opening 700; Personal bank account opening  remote 1 050; Business bank account opening 1 000; Business bank account opening  remote 1 500; Personal and business accounts together 1 500; Personal and business accounts together  remote 2 250.
- [Work permit and sole trader status for foreigners in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/work-permit-and-sole-trader/): Since 1 March 2026, foreigners need the right to labour activity to work or do business in Georgia. We check whether it applies to you and sort out your status — from the permit to your taxes.
- [Residence permit in Georgia — lawyer for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/residence-permit-in-georgia/): We prepare and file residence permit applications for foreigners in Georgia, follow them through the Public Service Hall and appeal refusals.
- [Family lawyer for foreigners in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/family-law-for-foreigners/): Family cases with an international element follow their own rules. We help with divorce, child residence and alimony, and the recognition of foreign court decisions — in English or Russian.
- [IT companies in Georgia: virtual zone, 5% tax, 1%](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/it-companies-in-georgia/): Georgia has no separate immigration law for IT, but it has three tax regimes that IT specialists and companies use. We help you choose the right one, register, obtain the status and sort out the right to work.
- [Gambling licence in Georgia — casino, betting, online](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/gambling-licence-georgia/): In Georgia, organising any game of chance or prize game — from a casino to online betting — requires a permit issued by the Revenue Service. Permits are issued only to businesses registered in Georgia. We help register the company, choose and obtain the right permit, and then comply with the permit conditions.
- [Georgian citizenship for foreigners — how to get it](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/georgian-citizenship-for-foreigners/): A foreigner can become a Georgian citizen in several ways — through residence, marriage, birth in Georgia or an exceptional grant. The President of Georgia decides; applications go to the Public Service Development Agency or a consulate. We choose the right route for you, prepare the documents and defend your interests if you are refused.
- [Marriage in Georgia for foreigners — requirements](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/marriage-in-georgia-for-foreigners/): Foreigners can register a marriage in Georgia — with a Georgian citizen or with each other, if they are in the country lawfully. There is no mandatory waiting period: a marriage is often registered on the day of application. We prepare the documents, translations and apostilles so you can use the marriage certificate in your own country.
- [Driving in Georgia on a foreign licence — the rules](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/driving-licence-georgia-foreigners/): A foreigner can drive in Georgia on their national licence, but not indefinitely — for 1 year from their last entry. After that you need to exchange it for a Georgian licence or get a Georgian one. We help prepare the documents and defend you in fine and driving-ban cases.
- [Opening a bank account in Georgia as a foreigner](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/bank-account-in-georgia-for-foreigners/): A foreigner can open an account at a Georgian bank — sometimes with just a passport. But the bank must understand who you are and where your money comes from, and if it can't, it won't open the account. We prepare the documents, help you deal with the bank and open personal and business accounts.
- [Tax residency in Georgia — 183 days, certificate, HNWI](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/tax-residency-georgia/): You become a Georgian tax resident if you spend 183 days or more in Georgia in any continuous 12-month period. A resident individual's foreign-source income is not taxed in Georgia. We help confirm residency, obtain the certificate, apply for HNWI status and handle disputes with the Revenue Service.
- [Georgia double tax treaties — US, UK, Germany](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/double-tax-treaties-georgia/): If you are connected to two countries, both may try to tax your income. A double tax treaty decides which country taxes it and at what rate. Georgia has 58 such treaties. We help you claim treaty relief and prove your residency.
- [Crypto in Georgia — tax and VASP registration](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/crypto-in-georgia/): In Georgia, income an individual receives from supplying crypto assets is exempt from personal income tax — as the Ministry of Finance has ruled. A crypto business — exchange, conversion, transfers, custody — may operate only after registering with the National Bank. We help set up the company, obtain VASP registration and meet AML requirements.
- [Checking a Georgian company — registry, debts, courts](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/checking-a-georgian-company/): Before you do business with a Georgian company, buy property or pay an advance, check who stands behind it and what risks it carries. In Georgia, much of this information is public. We check the company in every source and give you a clear report — in English, Russian or Georgian.
- [Can foreigners buy land in Georgia? Agricultural land](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/can-foreigners-buy-land-in-georgia/): Foreigners can buy flats, houses and non-agricultural land in Georgia. Agricultural land, under the Constitution, may belong only to the state, municipalities and Georgian citizens — with narrow exceptions. We check the land category, choose a lawful route and protect your investment.
- [Working remotely from Georgia — tax, visa, work permit](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/working-remotely-from-georgia/): Many foreigners live in Georgia and work remotely for a foreign employer or foreign clients. Staying is simple — tax is where most people go wrong: pay for work you do while physically in Georgia is Georgian income, even if your employer and your bank are abroad. We assess your situation and set it up correctly.

## For Georgians living abroad

- [Legal help for Georgians living abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/): We handle your matter in Georgia without you having to travel — by power of attorney, remote consultations and constant contact on WhatsApp.
- [Accepting an inheritance in Georgia from abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/accepting-an-inheritance/): A family member has died in Georgia and you live abroad? You can accept the inheritance without coming — the key is not to miss the 6-month deadline.
- [Selling or buying property in Georgia from abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/selling-property-from-abroad/): Living abroad and need to sell, buy or rent out property in Georgia? We do it in your name — so that your money and your property stay protected.
- [Debts and enforcement in Georgia while you live abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/debts-and-enforcement/): Living abroad and found out you are on Georgia's debtors' register, or your property has been seized? We find out where the debt comes from and find a way out.
- [Restoring and keeping Georgian citizenship](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/restoring-georgian-citizenship/): Did you lose Georgian citizenship when you became a citizen of another country? The law gives a temporary chance to get it back until 1 January 2027 — without giving up your other citizenship.

## Crimes and penalties (Criminal Code of Georgia)

- [Crimes and penalties in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/): Short and clear: what each crime means, which article of the Criminal Code covers it, what the penalty is and what to do if you are accused or are a victim.
- [Theft in Georgia — Article 177: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/theft-article-177/): Secretly taking someone else's property. Penalties range from a fine to 10 years, depending on the damage and circumstances.
- [Robbery in Georgia — Article 178: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/robbery-article-178/): Openly taking someone else's property. Penalties range from a fine to 11 years, depending on the damage, violence and other factors.
- [Violent robbery in Georgia — Article 179](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/violent-robbery-article-179/): An attack to take property, with violence dangerous to life or health or the threat of it. Penalty: 5 to 15 years.
- [Extortion in Georgia — Article 181: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/extortion-article-181/): Demanding money or property under threat of violence, damage or spreading compromising information. Up to 9 years.
- [Embezzlement in Georgia — Article 182: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/embezzlement-article-182/): Unlawfully keeping or spending property or money you were entrusted with — often at work. Up to 11 years.
- [Damage to property in Georgia — Article 187](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/property-damage-article-187/): Damaging or destroying someone else's property causing significant damage. Penalties from a fine to 12 years.
- [Bodily harm in Georgia — Articles 117, 118, 120](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/bodily-harm/): Intentional minor, less serious and serious bodily harm — penalties from a fine to 14 years.
- [Hooliganism in Georgia — Article 239: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/hooliganism-article-239/): A gross breach of public order with violence or the threat of violence. Penalties from a fine to 7 years.
- [Traffic accident in Georgia — Article 276: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/traffic-accident-article-276/): Breaking traffic safety rules causing injury or death; driving under the influence of drugs. Up to 12 years.
- [Bribe-taking in Georgia — Article 338: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/bribe-taking-article-338/): An official taking or demanding money or another benefit for an official act. Penalty: 6 to 15 years.
- [Bribe-giving in Georgia — Article 339: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/bribe-giving-article-339/): Offering or giving money or a benefit to an official. From a fine to 8 years; a voluntary report releases from liability.
- [Trading in influence in Georgia — Article 339¹](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/trading-in-influence-article-339-1/): Selling or buying 'connections' — promising, for money, to influence an official's decision. Up to 7 years.
- [Prohibited gifts to officials in Georgia — Article 340](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/prohibited-gift-article-340/): An official accepting a gift the law prohibits. From a fine to 4 years in prison.
- [Official forgery in Georgia — Article 341](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/official-forgery-article-341/): An official making a false entry in an official document or issuing a false document. From a fine to 4 years.
- [Disobeying the police — Article 173 (admin.)](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/disobeying-police-article-173/): Disobeying a lawful police demand or insulting an officer: a fine up to GEL 5,000 or up to 60 days of administrative detention.
- [Petty hooliganism in Georgia — Article 166 (admin.)](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/petty-hooliganism-article-166/): Swearing and insulting people in public: a fine up to GEL 3,000 or up to 20 days of administrative detention.
- [Account hacking in Georgia — Article 284: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/hacking-article-284/): Unlawfully getting into someone else's account, email, phone or computer. From a fine to 6 years.
- [Phishing and online theft in Georgia — Article 286¹](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/phishing-online-theft-article-286-1/): Phishing, taking money with someone else's card or online banking, interfering with systems for money. Up to 11 years.
- [Sharing private photos in Georgia — Articles 157, 157¹](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/private-photos-article-157/): Unlawfully obtaining and spreading private information, photos or personal data. Up to 10 years.
- [Domestic violence in Georgia — Article 126¹: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/domestic-violence-article-126-1/): Violence, systematic insults, blackmail or humiliation of a family member. Up to 3 years and a restraining order.
- [Murder in Georgia — Articles 108, 109: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/murder-article-108-109/): Intentional murder, murder with aggravating circumstances, attempted murder and causing death by negligence. Up to life imprisonment.
- [Illegal firearms in Georgia — Article 236: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/illegal-firearms-article-236/): Illegally acquiring, keeping, carrying or selling a firearm, ammunition or explosives. Up to 11 years.
